parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paged queries. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 99. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The resource ID.

- **ResourceType=PV**: The persistent volume ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid value:

- **PV**: persistent volume (PV).
